newsitem.title: UK: TENNIS-ALL BETS ARE OFF AT WIMBLEDON.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-ALL BETS ARE OFF AT WIMBLEDON.

text.p: Nearly $10 million is expected to be wagered on Wimbledon this year -- but none of it at the tournament itself.
While many major sports events have betting shops or tents on site, Wimbledon continues to hold out.
William Hill spokesman Graham Sharpe said: "We ran a betting facility at the tournament in 1975 and it proved hugely popular with spectators.
"However, we were unable to agree terms for the next year and Wimbledon has been without an on-site betting shop ever since."
The bookmakers are hoping Wimbledon will have a change of heart, but the All England Club will only say of a possible betting site: "It's not something we want here at the moment."
Pete Sampras is favourite to win the men's title at 6-4 with Martina Hingis 8-11 to lift the women's championship.
